description: This line plot illustrates the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” for four different vision-language models across varying input lengths, as measured on two distinct safety benchmarks. The x-axis represents the input length, scaled linearly from 128 to 1024, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 256 (128, 256, 512, 1024). The y-axis represents the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.5. Four distinct lines are plotted: the blue line with circular markers represents “LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep,” starting at approximately 0.15 at input length 128 and rising to about 0.36 at 1024; the orange line with square markers represents “Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep,” beginning at roughly 0.12 at 128 and increasing to approximately 0.42 at 1024; the green line with triangular markers represents “LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench,” starting at 0.05 at 128 and rising to about 0.37 at 1024; and the red line with diamond markers represents “Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench,” beginning at approximately 0.22 at 128, increasing to about 0.42 at 512, and then leveling off to 0.51 at 1024.
